definitions: Any of several eared seals of the family Otariidae, especially of the genera Callorhinus and Arctocephalus, found mainly in subpolar and temperate waters of the Pacific and Southern Hemispheres, having a dense, soft undercoat of fur.
examples: Fur seals are known for their thick fur.
The colony of fur seals was thriving.
Many fur seals were spotted near the coast.
